links.comparator_used: Basic and complex prompts (without Delphi-derived expert knowledge) across six open-source LLMs
links.outcome: Item-level PABAK and F1 for Padua and Caprini VTE risk scoring from unstructured EHRs
links.effect: Expert knowledge-augmented prompts showed the highest performance in both datasets; in the test dataset mean item-level PABAK and F1 were 0.97 and 0.96 for Padua, and 0.97 and 0.93 for Caprini
links.tradeoff: Processing time of 6.07 s per case for Padua and 12.82 s per case for Caprini; Caprini risk stratification was weaker (PABAK 0.73; F1 0.64) than Padua (PABAK 0.92; F1 0.96)
links.quote: Expert knowledge-augmented prompts showed the highest performance in both datasets.
